title: HOW TO DATAMOSH: PART 1
summary: A how-to video on datamoshing, the glitch-art technique of removing keyframes so that motion data smears across video. It walks through the tools needed, such as ffmpegx and Avidemux, though the author notes parts are outdated.
why: Cited in glitch-art threads as the non-programmatic way to datamosh by deleting keyframes.

quote.text: Check out this how-to for the non-Ruby way to do it
